comment: Third-party sources that FreeSense kernel modules build from. apply.sh fetches them into the freebsd-src checkout after the patches (scripts/kernel-contrib.sh). Each source is pinned by commit or sha256; a mismatch fails the build.

nasm.used_by: assembles intel-ipsec-mb for sys/modules/ipsecmb; built from source so the worker tools and the FreeBSD pin stay unchanged
